from lfx.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput
from lfx.io import (
    DropdownInput,
    FileInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
)
from lfx.schema.image import get_file_paths
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.services.deps import get_settings_service
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)
from lfx.utils.file_path_security import (
    component_file_access_scopes,
    enforce_local_file_access,
    is_local_file_access_restricted,
)


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        # Build endpoints inject caller-controlled file references directly into
        # ChatInput. Resolve and validate local references before the Message can
        # later read them while constructing model attachment content.
        if files:
            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            storage_type = getattr(getattr(settings_service, "settings", None), "storage_type", "local")
            # The storage factory falls back to local storage for unsupported
            # values, so only the explicitly configured S3 backend may bypass
            # filesystem containment.
            if str(storage_type).lower() != "s3" and is_local_file_access_restricted():
                scope_ids = list(component_file_access_scopes(self))
                # Public executions replace graph.flow_id with a per-visitor
                # virtual ID. Only the server-populated source provenance may
                # restore the already-validated public attachment namespace.
                source_flow_id = getattr(self.graph, "source_flow_id", None)
                if source_flow_id:
                    scope_ids.append(source_flow_id)
                for file_path in get_file_paths(files):
                    enforce_local_file_access(file_path, scope_ids=scope_ids)

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

from collections.abc import Generator
from typing import Any

import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.helpers.data import safe_convert
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput, DropdownInput, HandleInput, MessageTextInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.schema.properties import Source
from lfx.template.field.base import Output
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)


class ChatOutput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Display a chat message in the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Inputs",
            info="Message to be passed as output.",
            input_types=["Data", "JSON", "DataFrame", "Table", "Message"],
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
            advanced=True,
            info="Type of sender.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="data_template",
            display_name="Data Template",
            value="{text}",
            advanced=True,
            info="Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="clean_data",
            display_name="Basic Clean Data",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
            info="Whether to clean data before converting to string.",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and not self.is_connected_to_chat_input():
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
            # Preserve existing session_id from the incoming message if it exists
            existing_session_id = message.session_id
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
            existing_session_id = None

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        # Preserve session_id from incoming message, or use component/graph session_id
        message.session_id = (
            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value, clean_data=clean_data)

ROLE: You turn a project description and timeline into a structured, ready-to-use project plan for a PM/TPM.

METHOD:
1. Restate the objective and the goals EXACTLY as written in the PROJECT DESCRIPTION (quote the stated targets; do not add new goals, KPIs or numbers).
2. Build the plan from the TIMELINE table: one section per phase with weeks, calendar dates, key activities, milestones/deliverables, and the board tasks mapped to that phase (task ID, name, owner).
3. Add a 'Governance' line using only what the description says (cross-functional task force of data scientists, IT professionals and business stakeholders).
4. Add 'Dependencies & gates' derived from phase order (e.g. pilot cannot start before use cases are selected).
5. Add 'Open questions / assumptions' for anything a real plan needs but the data does not contain (budget, named sponsor, department chosen for pilot, etc.).

OUTPUT FORMAT (Markdown):
# Project Plan - <project name>
## 1. Objective & Stated Goals
## 2. Timeline at a Glance (table: Phase | Weeks | Dates | Key milestone)
## 3. Phase Details (per phase: activities, milestones/deliverables, mapped tasks, owner(s))
## 4. Governance & Team
## 5. Dependencies & Gates
## 6. Open Questions & Assumptions (clearly labelled)

If the packet contains a NEW PROJECT BRIEF instead, plan only from that brief and list every assumption explicitly.

"""Mira - Orchestrator (Router / Dispatcher pattern).

1. Classifies the request (LLM + keyword rules, hybrid) into one specialist route.
2. Runs a deterministic sufficiency gate: requests about a *new* project whose brief is too
   thin (T2, T4, T6, T9) are sent to the Clarification agent instead of a generator.
3. Builds a route-specific, data-grounded context packet from the Project Knowledge Base,
   so each specialist only sees the facts it needs (fewer tokens, less room to invent).
4. Activates exactly one output branch; the others are stopped (Langflow conditional routing).

Self-contained so it can be pasted into a Langflow "Custom Component" node.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, DropdownInput, HandleInput, MessageTextInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message

ROUTES = ["planner", "risk", "status", "tracker", "stakeholder", "clarify"]
OUTPUT_FOR_ROUTE = {r: f"to_{r}" for r in ROUTES}

CLASSIFIER_PROMPT = """You are the intent classifier for Mira, a project-intelligence assistant.
Mira is currently loaded with ONE project: the ABCDE Ltd. AI Adoption Project (description, timeline,
risk register, task board). Classify the user's request. Reply with JSON only, no prose:
{"intent": "planner|risk|status|tracker|stakeholder|other",
 "project_ref": "loaded_project|new_project",
 "inline_brief": "<the user's own project description if they supplied one, else empty>",
 "brief_is_sufficient": true|false,
 "missing": ["scope", "goals", "timeline", "team size", "deliverables", "task data", ...]}

Intent guide:
- planner: create a project plan / phases / roadmap
- risk: risk assessment, risk matrix, top risks
- status: weekly status report, task counts, progress summary
- tracker: blocked tasks, tasks at risk of missing deadlines, upcoming or at-risk milestones
- stakeholder: stakeholder / executive / client update or email
project_ref = new_project when the user describes some OTHER project inline (e.g. "for: 'We want to build
a chatbot'", "for a 2-week project"). Requests that mention ABCDE, "the task board", "the timeline",
"the risk data", a sprint number, or "the current project" refer to the loaded_project.
brief_is_sufficient applies only to new_project: true only if the brief states scope/goals AND a timeline
AND team/resources (for status reports: actual task data). One sentence is never sufficient.

Examples:
"Generate a project plan for: 'We want to build a mobile app.'" -> {"intent":"planner","project_ref":"new_project","inline_brief":"We want to build a mobile app.","brief_is_sufficient":false,"missing":["scope","goals","timeline","team size","deliverables"]}
"Which tasks are overdue on the board?" -> {"intent":"tracker","project_ref":"loaded_project","inline_brief":"","brief_is_sufficient":true,"missing":[]}

Request: {request}"""


def _norm(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (text or "")).strip()


def rule_classify(request: str) -> dict:
    """Deterministic classifier - also the fallback when no LLM is connected."""
    q = _norm(request)
    low = q.lower()

    # --- inline brief (a different / new project described in the request) ---
    brief = ""
    m = re.search(r"for:?\s*[\"'“‘](.+?)[\"'”’]", q)
    if m:
        brief = m.group(1).strip()
    elif re.search(r"\bfor:\s*\S", q):
        brief = q.split("for:", 1)[1].strip()
    elif re.search(r"\bfor an? (?:new |)\S*[- ]?(?:week|month|day)?.*project\b", low) and not re.search(
            r"abcde|ai adoption", low):
        brief = re.split(r"\bfor\b", q, maxsplit=1)[1].strip()
    mentions_loaded = bool(re.search(
        r"abcde|ai adoption|task board|the timeline|risk data|risk register|provided|sprint\s*\d|"
        r"current project|the project|this project|board", low))
    project_ref = "new_project" if brief and not re.search(r"abcde|ai adoption", low) else "loaded_project"
    if not brief and not mentions_loaded and re.search(r"\bnew project\b", low):
        project_ref, brief = "new_project", q

    # --- intent ---
    if re.search(r"stakeholder|e-?mail|executive|leadership update|client update|newsletter", low):
        intent = "stakeholder"
    elif re.search(r"how many|counts?\b|summari[sz]e (?:the )?(?:current )?(?:project )?status|weekly status", low):
        intent = "status"
    elif re.search(r"\bblocked\b|deadline|overdue|slipp|milestone|behind schedule|late\b", low):
        intent = "tracker"
    elif re.search(r"\brisk", low):
        intent = "risk"
    elif re.search(r"status|how many tasks|progress|summar|report|done, in progress|burndown", low):
        intent = "status"
    elif re.search(r"\bplan\b|roadmap|phases|work breakdown|wbs|schedule", low):
        intent = "planner"
    else:
        intent = "other"

    # --- sufficiency of an inline brief ---
    missing: list[str] = []
    if project_ref == "new_project":
        b = brief.lower()
        words = len(b.split())
        has_scope = bool(re.search(r"scope|goal|objective|deliverable|feature|users?|requirement|kpi|reduce|improve",
                                   b)) and words >= 12
        has_time = bool(re.search(r"\d+\s*-?\s*(?:day|week|month|sprint)s?|deadline|by (?:q\d|jan|feb|mar|apr|may|"
                                  r"jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)|timeline", b))
        has_team = bool(re.search(r"team|engineer|developer|people|members|analyst|designer|budget|resources", b))
        has_tasks = bool(re.search(r"task_id|\bT\d{3}\b|status,|to do|in progress|done", brief))
        if intent == "status":
            if not has_tasks:
                missing = ["task data (task board export or list of tasks with status, owner, due date)"]
        else:
            if not has_scope:
                missing += ["scope & goals", "key deliverables"]
            if not has_time:
                missing.append("timeline / deadline")
            if not has_team:
                missing.append("team size & roles")
            if words < 25 and "scope & goals" not in missing:
                missing.insert(0, "more detailed scope & goals")
    return {"intent": intent, "project_ref": project_ref, "inline_brief": brief,
            "brief_is_sufficient": not missing, "missing": missing}


def _md_table(rows: list[dict], cols: list[str]) -> str:
    if not rows:
        return "_(none)_"
    head = "| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |\n|" + "---|" * len(cols) + "\n"
    body = "\n".join("| " + " | ".join(str(r.get(c, "")).replace("|", "/") for c in cols) + " |" for r in rows)
    return head + body


TASK_COLS = ["task_id", "task_name", "status", "assignee", "priority", "sprint", "due_date", "flags"]


def _tasks(rows):
    return [{**t, "flags": ", ".join(t["flags"]) or "-"} for t in rows]


def build_packet(route: str, request: str, decision: dict, f: dict) -> str:
    """Route-specific grounded context. Only facts in this packet may appear in the answer."""
    header = {"route": route, "sprint": decision.get("sprint"), "audience": decision.get("audience"),
              "top_n": decision.get("top_n")}
    parts = [f"<!--MIRA {json.dumps(header)}-->",
             f"## USER REQUEST\n{request}",
             f"## PROJECT\n{f['project_name']} | As-of date: {f['as_of_date']} | Project week "
             f"{f['current_project_week']} | Current sprint: {f['current_sprint']}"]
    phases_rows = [{"phase": p["phase"], "phase_name": p["phase_name"], "weeks": f'{p["start_week"]}-{p["end_week"]}',
                    "dates": f'{p["start_date"]} -> {p["due_date"]}', "milestones": "; ".join(p["milestones"]),
                    "status": p["status"], "problem_tasks": ", ".join(p["problem_tasks"]) or "-"} for p in f["phases"]]

    if route == "planner":
        parts += [
            f"## PROJECT DESCRIPTION (only source of goals)\n{f['description']}",
            f"## STATED NUMERIC TARGETS (the ONLY numbers you may use as targets)\n{', '.join(f['stated_numeric_targets'])}",
            "## TIMELINE (project_timeline.csv)\n" + _md_table(
                [{**r, "activities": "; ".join(p["key_activities"])} for r, p in zip(phases_rows, f["phases"])],
                ["phase", "phase_name", "weeks", "dates", "activities", "milestones"]),
            "## TASKS MAPPED TO PHASES (sample_task_board.csv)\n" + "\n".join(
                f'- Phase {p["phase"]}: ' + (", ".join(
                    f'{t["task_id"]} {t["task_name"]} ({t["assignee"]})' for t in f["tasks"]
                    if t["task_id"] in p["tasks"]) or "no tasks yet") for p in f["phases"]),
        ]
    elif route == "risk":
        parts += [
            f"## PROJECT DESCRIPTION\n{f['description']}",
            "## RISK REGISTER (project_risks.csv) with live evidence from the task board\n" + _md_table(
                [{**r, "related_tasks": ", ".join(r["related_tasks"]) or "-",
                  "live_signals": "; ".join(r["live_signals"]) or "none"} for r in
                 sorted(f["risks"], key=lambda x: x["exposure_rank"])],
                ["exposure_rank", "risk_id", "category", "risk_challenge", "impact", "mitigation_strategy",
                 "related_tasks", "live_signals", "exposure_score"]),
            "## EXPOSURE SCORING METHOD\nexposure = sum over related OPEN tasks of 0.5 + (BLOCKED 3x / OVERDUE 2x / "
            "due-within-7-days 1x) * priority weight (High 3, Medium 2, Low 1). Higher = more live evidence. "
            f"Top 3 by exposure: {', '.join(f['top_risks_by_exposure'])}.",
        ]
    elif route == "status":
        sprint = decision.get("sprint")
        scope_tasks = [t for t in f["tasks"] if sprint is None or t["sprint_num"] == sprint]
        label = f"Sprint {sprint}" if sprint else "Whole project"
        sc = f["status_counts_by_sprint"].get(f"Sprint {sprint}", {}) if sprint else f["status_counts"]
        parts += [
            f"## SCOPE: {label}" + (f' ({f["sprints"].get(f"Sprint {sprint}", {}).get("start_date")} -> '
                                     f'{f["sprints"].get(f"Sprint {sprint}", {}).get("end_date")})' if sprint else ""),
            f"## EXACT COUNTS - {label} (pre-computed, copy exactly)\n" + json.dumps(sc),
            "## EXACT COUNTS - whole project\n" + json.dumps(f["status_counts"]),
            f"## TASKS IN SCOPE ({label})\n" + _md_table(_tasks(scope_tasks), TASK_COLS),
            "## PROJECT-WIDE BLOCKERS & OVERDUE ITEMS\n" + _md_table(
                _tasks(f["blocked_tasks"] + f["overdue_tasks"]), TASK_COLS),
            f"## MILESTONES DUE BY {f['horizon_end_date']}\n" + _md_table(
                [r for r in phases_rows if any(p["phase"] == r["phase"] for p in f["upcoming_milestones"])],
                ["phase", "phase_name", "dates", "milestones", "status", "problem_tasks"]),
            f"## OVERALL HEALTH (rule-based)\n{f['health']['rag']} - " + ("; ".join(f["health"]["reasons"]) or "no issues"),
            "## OPEN WORK PER PERSON\n" + "\n".join(
                f'- {k}: {v["open_tasks"]} open ({v["high_priority_open"]} high)' for k, v in f["workload"].items()),
        ]
    elif route == "tracker":
        parts += [
            "## BLOCKED TASKS\n" + _md_table(_tasks(f["blocked_tasks"]), TASK_COLS + ["description"]),
            f"## OVERDUE (due before {f['as_of_date']}, not Done)\n" + _md_table(_tasks(f["overdue_tasks"]), TASK_COLS),
            "## DUE WITHIN 7 DAYS AND NOT DONE\n" + _md_table(_tasks(f["due_within_7_days"]), TASK_COLS),
            f"## MILESTONES DUE IN LOOK-AHEAD WINDOW ({f['as_of_date']} -> {f['horizon_end_date']})\n" + _md_table(
                [r for r in phases_rows if any(p["phase"] == r["phase"] for p in f["upcoming_milestones"])],
                ["phase", "phase_name", "dates", "milestones", "status", "problem_tasks"]),
            "## ALL MILESTONES (project_timeline.csv) WITH STATUS\n" + _md_table(
                phases_rows, ["phase", "phase_name", "dates", "milestones", "status", "problem_tasks"]),
        ]
    elif route == "stakeholder":
        sprint = decision.get("sprint") or (int(f["current_sprint"].split()[-1]) if f["current_sprint"] else None)
        scope_tasks = [t for t in f["tasks"] if t["sprint_num"] == sprint]
        sp = f["sprints"].get(f"Sprint {sprint}", {})
        in_window = [r for r, p in zip(phases_rows, f["phases"])
                     if sp and sp["start_date"] <= p["due_date"] <= sp["end_date"]]
        parts += [
            f"## AUDIENCE: {decision.get('audience') or 'leadership'}",
            f"## SCOPE: Sprint {sprint} ONLY ({sp.get('start_date')} -> {sp.get('end_date')}). "
            "Do NOT mention tasks from any other sprint.",
            f"## EXACT COUNTS - Sprint {sprint}\n" + json.dumps(f["status_counts_by_sprint"].get(f"Sprint {sprint}", {})),
            f"## SPRINT {sprint} TASKS\n" + _md_table(_tasks(scope_tasks), TASK_COLS + ["description"]),
            f"## MILESTONES FALLING IN SPRINT {sprint}\n" + _md_table(
                in_window, ["phase", "phase_name", "dates", "milestones", "status"]),
            f"## PROJECT GOALS (from description)\nTargets: {', '.join(f['stated_numeric_targets'])} - "
            "reduce delivery delays by 15%, lower operational costs by 10%, improve service responsiveness.",
        ]
    elif route == "clarify":
        parts += [
            f"## WHY CLARIFICATION IS NEEDED\nIntent: {decision['intent']} | Refers to: {decision['project_ref']}",
            f"## USER-SUPPLIED BRIEF\n\"{decision.get('inline_brief') or request}\"",
            "## MISSING INFORMATION (deterministic check)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {m}" for m in decision["missing"]),
            "## WHAT MIRA CAN DO WITH THE LOADED PROJECT\nProject plans, risk assessments, weekly status reports, "
            "blocked/at-risk task and milestone alerts, stakeholder update emails for the ABCDE Ltd. AI Adoption Project.",
        ]
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


class MiraOrchestrator(Component):
    display_name = "Mira · Orchestrator (Router)"
    description = ("Classifies the request, gates vague inputs, builds a grounded context packet and routes it "
                   "to exactly one specialist agent.")
    icon = "split"
    name = "MiraOrchestrator"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(name="request", display_name="User Request", required=True),
        DataInput(name="knowledge_base", display_name="Project Facts", required=True,
                  info="Output of Mira · Project Knowledge Base."),
        HandleInput(name="llm", display_name="Classifier LLM", input_types=["LanguageModel"], required=False,
                    info="Optional. Without it the deterministic rule classifier is used."),
        DropdownInput(name="routing_mode", display_name="Routing Mode",
                      options=["Hybrid (LLM + rules)", "Rules only"], value="Hybrid (LLM + rules)"),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="→ Planner Agent", name="to_planner", method="out_planner", group_outputs=True),
        Output(display_name="→ Risk Assessor", name="to_risk", method="out_risk", group_outputs=True),
        Output(display_name="→ Status Reporter", name="to_status", method="out_status", group_outputs=True),
        Output(display_name="→ Milestone Tracker", name="to_tracker", method="out_tracker", group_outputs=True),
        Output(display_name="→ Stakeholder Comms", name="to_stakeholder", method="out_stakeholder",
               group_outputs=True),
        Output(display_name="→ Clarification Agent", name="to_clarify", method="out_clarify", group_outputs=True),
    ]

    def _pre_run_setup(self):
        self._mira_decision = None
        self._excluded_outputs = set()

    # ---------------- classification ----------------
    def _llm_classify(self, request: str) -> dict | None:
        if not self.llm or self.routing_mode == "Rules only":
            return None
        try:
            prompt = CLASSIFIER_PROMPT.replace("{request}", request)
            resp = self.llm.invoke(prompt, config={"callbacks": self.get_langchain_callbacks(),
                                                   "run_name": "mira_intent_classifier"})
            text = getattr(resp, "content", str(resp))
            m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.S)
            return json.loads(m.group()) if m else None
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - fall back to rules, but record why
            self.log(f"LLM classifier failed, using rules: {e}")
            return None

    def _decide(self) -> dict:
        if getattr(self, "_mira_decision", None):
            return self._mira_decision
        raw = self.request
        request = _norm(raw if isinstance(raw, str) else getattr(raw, "text", "") or "")
        rules = rule_classify(request)
        llm = self._llm_classify(request)
        d = dict(rules)
        d["classifier"] = "rules"
        if llm:
            d["classifier"] = "hybrid"
            if llm.get("intent") in ROUTES or llm.get("intent") == "other":
                d["intent"] = llm["intent"]
            # Conservative merge: a request is 'new project' if EITHER says so; sufficient only if BOTH agree.
            if llm.get("project_ref") == "new_project" and rules["project_ref"] == "loaded_project" \
                    and llm.get("inline_brief"):
                d["project_ref"], d["inline_brief"] = "new_project", llm["inline_brief"]
            if d["project_ref"] == "new_project":
                both_ok = rules["brief_is_sufficient"] and bool(llm.get("brief_is_sufficient"))
                d["brief_is_sufficient"] = both_ok
                d["missing"] = list(dict.fromkeys(rules["missing"] + (llm.get("missing") or []))) if not both_ok else []
            d["llm_raw"] = llm
        sm = re.search(r"sprint\s*(\d+)", request, re.I)
        d["sprint"] = int(sm.group(1)) if sm else None
        tn = re.search(r"top\s*(\d+)", request, re.I)
        d["top_n"] = int(tn.group(1)) if tn else None
        aud = re.search(r"(leadership|executive|engineering|client|customer)", request, re.I)
        d["audience"] = aud.group(1).lower() if aud else None

        facts = self.knowledge_base.data if self.knowledge_base else {}
        if d["intent"] == "other":
            d["missing"] = ["a supported request type (plan, risk assessment, status report, "
                            "blocked/at-risk tracking, stakeholder update)"]
            route = "clarify"
        elif d["project_ref"] == "new_project" and not d["brief_is_sufficient"]:
            route = "clarify"
        elif d["project_ref"] == "new_project":
            route = d["intent"]  # sufficient new brief: specialist works from the brief
        else:
            needed = {"planner": "description", "risk": "risks", "status": "task_board", "tracker": "task_board",
                      "stakeholder": "task_board"}[d["intent"]]
            if not facts.get("data_available", {}).get(needed):
                d["missing"] = [f"{needed.replace('_', ' ')} data for the loaded project"]
                route = "clarify"
            else:
                route = d["intent"]
        d["route"] = route
        d["packet"] = build_packet(route, request, d, facts) if facts else f"## USER REQUEST\n{request}"
        if d["project_ref"] == "new_project" and route != "clarify":
            d["packet"] += f"\n\n## NEW PROJECT BRIEF (use ONLY this, not the ABCDE data)\n{d['inline_brief']}"
        self._mira_decision = d
        self.status = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k != "packet"}
        return d

    # ---------------- branch activation ----------------
    def _emit(self, route: str) -> Message:
        d = self._decide()
        if d["route"] == route:
            others = [OUTPUT_FOR_ROUTE[r] for r in ROUTES if r != route]
            for name in others:
                self.stop(name)
            if self._vertex is not None:
                self._excluded_outputs.update(others)
                self._vertex.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id, sorted(self._excluded_outputs))
            return Message(text=d["packet"])
        self.stop(OUTPUT_FOR_ROUTE[route])
        return Message(text="")

    def out_planner(self) -> Message:
        return self._emit("planner")

    def out_risk(self) -> Message:
        return self._emit("risk")

    def out_status(self) -> Message:
        return self._emit("status")

    def out_tracker(self) -> Message:
        return self._emit("tracker")

    def out_stakeholder(self) -> Message:
        return self._emit("stakeholder")

    def out_clarify(self) -> Message:
        return self._emit("clarify")

"""Mira - Project Knowledge Base (data-grounding layer).

Parses the four ABCDE Ltd. project files and pre-computes every fact that must be
exactly right (status counts, overdue / blocked tasks, milestone dates, risk exposure).
The LLM agents downstream only *explain* these facts; they never count or do date math.

Self-contained so it can be pasted into a Langflow "Custom Component" node.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import re
from datetime import date, timedelta

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import IntInput, MultilineInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data

STATUS_ORDER = ["Done", "In Progress", "Blocked", "To Do"]
PRIORITY_WEIGHT = {"High": 3, "Medium": 2, "Low": 1}

# Keywords that link each risk category in project_risks.csv to evidence on the task board.
RISK_EVIDENCE_KEYWORDS = {
    "Data Quality & Availability": ["data gap", "data quality", "data infrastructure", "historical demand",
                                    "data cleaning", "preprocessing"],
    "Integration Issues": ["erp", "deploy", "production deployment", "legacy"],
    "Talent & Skills Gap": ["task force", "staff training", "hire"],
    "Change Resistance": ["staff training", "pilot with logistics team", "pilot feedback", "rollout"],
    "Ethical & Legal Concerns": ["legal", "privacy", "compliance"],
    "Cost Overruns": ["vendor evaluation", "ml platform", "infrastructure scaling"],
    "Unrealistic Expectations": ["success criteria", "stakeholder", "kpi"],
    "Model Performance Drift": ["drift", "retrain", "continuous monitoring"],
    "Security Vulnerabilities": ["security", "penetration", "vulnerability"],
    "Vendor Lock-in": ["vendor", "ml platform", "sagemaker", "vertex", "azure ml"],
}


def _parse_csv(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    text = (text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return []
    return [{k.strip(): (v or "").strip() for k, v in row.items()} for row in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text))]


def _to_date(value: str) -> date | None:
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(value.strip())
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        return None


def build_project_facts(description: str, task_csv: str, timeline_csv: str, risks_csv: str,
                        as_of: str, project_start: str, horizon_days: int = 14) -> dict:
    """Pure function: all deterministic project facts Mira is allowed to use."""
    as_of_d = _to_date(as_of) or date.today()
    start_d = _to_date(project_start) or as_of_d
    horizon_d = as_of_d + timedelta(days=horizon_days)

    def week_start(week: int) -> date:
        return start_d + timedelta(weeks=week - 1)

    def week_end(week: int) -> date:  # Friday of that project week
        return week_start(week) + timedelta(days=4)

    def week_of(d: date) -> int:
        return (d - start_d).days // 7 + 1

    current_week = week_of(as_of_d)

    # ---------------- Timeline / milestones ----------------
    phases = []
    for row in _parse_csv(timeline_csv):
        try:
            sw, ew = int(row["start_week"]), int(row["end_week"])
        except (KeyError, ValueError):
            continue
        phases.append({
            "phase": int(row.get("phase", len(phases) + 1)),
            "phase_name": row.get("phase_name", ""),
            "start_week": sw,
            "end_week": ew,
            "start_date": week_start(sw).isoformat(),
            "due_date": week_end(ew).isoformat(),
            "key_activities": [a.strip() for a in row.get("key_activities", "").split(";") if a.strip()],
            "milestones": [m.strip() for m in row.get("milestones_deliverables", "").split(";") if m.strip()],
            "tasks": [],
        })

    def phase_for_week(w: int) -> dict | None:
        for p in phases:
            if p["start_week"] <= w <= p["end_week"]:
                return p
        return phases[-1] if phases and w > phases[-1]["end_week"] else None

    # ---------------- Task board ----------------
    tasks = []
    for row in _parse_csv(task_csv):
        due = _to_date(row.get("due_date", ""))
        status = row.get("status", "")
        sprint_match = re.search(r"\d+", row.get("sprint", ""))
        open_task = status != "Done"
        days_to_due = (due - as_of_d).days if due else None
        flags = []
        if status == "Blocked":
            flags.append("BLOCKED")
        if open_task and due and due < as_of_d:
            flags.append("OVERDUE")
        elif open_task and due and days_to_due is not None and days_to_due <= 7 and status != "Blocked":
            flags.append("DUE_WITHIN_7_DAYS_NOT_DONE")
        task = {
            "task_id": row.get("task_id", ""),
            "task_name": row.get("task_name", ""),
            "status": status,
            "assignee": row.get("assignee", ""),
            "priority": row.get("priority", ""),
            "sprint": row.get("sprint", ""),
            "sprint_num": int(sprint_match.group()) if sprint_match else None,
            "due_date": due.isoformat() if due else "",
            "days_to_due": days_to_due,
            "labels": row.get("labels", ""),
            "description": row.get("description", ""),
            "flags": flags,
        }
        if due:
            p = phase_for_week(week_of(due))
            if p:
                task["phase"] = p["phase"]
                p["tasks"].append(task["task_id"])
        tasks.append(task)

    by_id = {t["task_id"]: t for t in tasks}
    counts = {s: 0 for s in STATUS_ORDER}
    for t in tasks:
        counts[t["status"]] = counts.get(t["status"], 0) + 1
    counts_by_sprint: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for t in tasks:
        sp = counts_by_sprint.setdefault(t["sprint"], {s: 0 for s in STATUS_ORDER})
        sp[t["status"]] = sp.get(t["status"], 0) + 1

    sprints = {}
    for n in sorted({t["sprint_num"] for t in tasks if t["sprint_num"]}):
        sprints[f"Sprint {n}"] = {
            "start_date": week_start(2 * n - 1).isoformat(),
            "end_date": week_end(2 * n).isoformat(),
            "project_weeks": [2 * n - 1, 2 * n],
        }
    current_sprint = next((s for s, w in sprints.items() if current_week in w["project_weeks"]), None)

    # ---------------- Milestone status ----------------
    for p in phases:
        due = _to_date(p["due_date"])
        linked = [by_id[i] for i in p["tasks"]]
        open_linked = [t for t in linked if t["status"] != "Done"]
        problems = [t for t in open_linked if "BLOCKED" in t["flags"] or "OVERDUE" in t["flags"]]
        if linked and not open_linked:
            state = "COMPLETE (all linked tasks done)"
        elif due < as_of_d:
            state = "MISSED / OVERDUE" if open_linked else "PAST DUE (no linked tasks to verify)"
        elif problems:
            state = "AT RISK"
        elif any(t["status"] == "In Progress" for t in linked):
            state = "IN PROGRESS - ON TRACK"
        elif _to_date(p["start_date"]) <= as_of_d:
            state = "IN PROGRESS - ON TRACK"
        else:
            state = "NOT STARTED"
        p["status"] = state
        p["open_tasks"] = [t["task_id"] for t in open_linked]
        p["problem_tasks"] = [f'{t["task_id"]} ({", ".join(t["flags"])})' for t in problems]
        p["due_in_window"] = as_of_d <= due <= horizon_d

    upcoming = [p for p in phases if p["due_in_window"]]

    # ---------------- Risks ----------------
    risks = []
    for r in _parse_csv(risks_csv):
        keywords = RISK_EVIDENCE_KEYWORDS.get(r.get("category", ""), [])
        related, score = [], 0
        for t in tasks:
            hay = f'{t["task_name"]} {t["description"]} {t["labels"]}'.lower()
            if any(k in hay for k in keywords):
                related.append(t["task_id"])
                if t["status"] == "Done":
                    continue
                w = PRIORITY_WEIGHT.get(t["priority"], 1)
                score += 0.5  # breadth: open work exposed to this risk
                if "BLOCKED" in t["flags"]:
                    score += 3 * w
                if "OVERDUE" in t["flags"]:
                    score += 2 * w
                if "DUE_WITHIN_7_DAYS_NOT_DONE" in t["flags"]:
                    score += w
        risks.append({**r, "related_tasks": related, "exposure_score": score,
                      "live_signals": [f'{by_id[i]["task_id"]} {by_id[i]["status"]} {by_id[i]["flags"]}'
                                       for i in related if by_id[i]["flags"]]})
    ranked = sorted(risks, key=lambda x: (-x["exposure_score"], x.get("risk_id", "")))
    for i, r in enumerate(ranked, 1):
        r["exposure_rank"] = i

    # ---------------- Health (RAG) ----------------
    blocked = [t for t in tasks if "BLOCKED" in t["flags"]]
    overdue = [t for t in tasks if "OVERDUE" in t["flags"]]
    due_soon = [t for t in tasks if "DUE_WITHIN_7_DAYS_NOT_DONE" in t["flags"]]
    reasons = []
    if blocked:
        reasons.append(f"{len(blocked)} blocked task(s): " + ", ".join(t["task_id"] for t in blocked))
    if overdue:
        reasons.append(f"{len(overdue)} overdue task(s): " + ", ".join(t["task_id"] for t in overdue))
    missed = [p for p in phases if p["status"].startswith("MISSED")]
    if missed:
        reasons.append("missed milestone(s): " + ", ".join(f'Phase {p["phase"]}' for p in missed))
    high_overdue = [t for t in overdue if t["priority"] == "High"]
    if len(high_overdue) >= 2 or (blocked and any(t["days_to_due"] is not None and t["days_to_due"] <= 14
                                                  for t in blocked)) or len(missed) >= 2:
        health = "RED"
    elif blocked or overdue or missed:
        health = "AMBER"
    else:
        health = "GREEN"

    workload: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for t in tasks:
        if t["status"] == "Done":
            continue
        w = workload.setdefault(t["assignee"], {"open_tasks": 0, "high_priority_open": 0, "task_ids": []})
        w["open_tasks"] += 1
        w["high_priority_open"] += t["priority"] == "High"
        w["task_ids"].append(t["task_id"])

    stated_targets = re.findall(r"\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s?%", description or "")

    return {
        "project_name": "ABCDE Ltd. AI Adoption Project",
        "as_of_date": as_of_d.isoformat(),
        "project_start_date": start_d.isoformat(),
        "current_project_week": current_week,
        "current_sprint": current_sprint,
        "horizon_end_date": horizon_d.isoformat(),
        "description": (description or "").strip(),
        "stated_numeric_targets": stated_targets,
        "phases": phases,
        "upcoming_milestones": upcoming,
        "tasks": tasks,
        "task_ids": [t["task_id"] for t in tasks],
        "status_counts": {"total": len(tasks), **counts},
        "status_counts_by_sprint": counts_by_sprint,
        "sprints": sprints,
        "blocked_tasks": blocked,
        "overdue_tasks": overdue,
        "due_within_7_days": due_soon,
        "risks": risks,
        "risk_ids": [r.get("risk_id", "") for r in risks],
        "top_risks_by_exposure": [r.get("risk_id") for r in ranked[:3]],
        "health": {"rag": health, "reasons": reasons},
        "workload": workload,
        "data_available": {
            "description": bool((description or "").strip()),
            "task_board": bool(tasks),
            "timeline": bool(phases),
            "risks": bool(risks),
        },
    }


class MiraProjectKnowledgeBase(Component):
    display_name = "Mira · Project Knowledge Base"
    description = (
        "Data-grounding layer. Parses project description, task board, timeline and risk register, "
        "and pre-computes counts, overdue/blocked tasks, milestone dates and risk exposure."
    )
    icon = "database"
    name = "MiraProjectKnowledgeBase"

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(name="project_description", display_name="Project Description (txt)",
                       info="Paste project_description.txt or connect a File/Read File output."),
        MultilineInput(name="task_board_csv", display_name="Task Board (CSV)",
                       info="Paste sample_task_board.csv (or a Jira/Trello CSV export with the same columns)."),
        MultilineInput(name="timeline_csv", display_name="Project Timeline (CSV)"),
        MultilineInput(name="risks_csv", display_name="Risk Register (CSV)"),
        StrInput(name="as_of_date", display_name="Report As-Of Date (YYYY-MM-DD)", value="2026-04-24",
                 info="'Today' for status, overdue and upcoming-milestone calculations."),
        StrInput(name="project_start_date", display_name="Project Start Date (Week 1 Monday)", value="2026-03-30",
                 advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="horizon_days", display_name="Look-ahead Window (days)", value=14, advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Project Facts", name="facts", method="build_facts")]

    def build_facts(self) -> Data:

            description=self.project_description,
            task_csv=self.task_board_csv,

            as_of=self.as_of_date,

            f'Done {c["Done"]}, In Progress {c["In Progress"]}, Blocked {c["Blocked"]}, To Do {c["To Do"]}. '
            f'Health {facts["health"]["rag"]}.'
        )

import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.helpers.data import safe_convert
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput, DropdownInput, HandleInput, MessageTextInput
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.schema.properties import Source
from lfx.template.field.base import Output
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)


class ChatOutput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Display a chat message in the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Inputs",
            info="Message to be passed as output.",
            input_types=["Data", "JSON", "DataFrame", "Table", "Message"],
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
            advanced=True,
            info="Type of sender.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="data_template",
            display_name="Data Template",
            value="{text}",
            advanced=True,
            info="Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="clean_data",
            display_name="Basic Clean Data",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
            info="Whether to clean data before converting to string.",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and not self.is_connected_to_chat_input():
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
            # Preserve existing session_id from the incoming message if it exists
            existing_session_id = message.session_id
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
            existing_session_id = None

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        # Preserve session_id from incoming message, or use component/graph session_id
        message.session_id = (
            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value, clean_data=clean_data)

        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and not self.is_connected_to_chat_input():
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
            # Preserve existing session_id from the incoming message if it exists
            existing_session_id = message.session_id
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
            existing_session_id = None

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        # Preserve session_id from incoming message, or use component/graph session_id
        message.session_id = (
            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value, clean_data=clean_data)

# Mira - AI Project Intelligence Assistant
Pattern: Router / Dispatcher

1. Project Knowledge Base -  parses the 4 project files and pre-computes counts, overdue/blocked tasks, milestone dates and risk exposure.
2. Orchestrator - classifies the request (LLM + rules), blocks vague inputs, builds a grounded context and activates exactly 1 branch.
3. Specialist agents - answer only from their packet, then run a grounding validator.

### Specialist agents (one active per request)
- Planner - plan with phases, milestones, timeline
- Risk Assessor - risk matrix / top-N risks
- Status Reporter - weekly report, counts
- Milestone Tracker - blocked / at-risk / upcoming milestones 
- Stakeholder Comms - audience-tailored update email
- Clarification - insufficient input -> asks questions, never fabricates
